about.heroTitle: Twenty-five years supplying winding and insulation materials
about.heroDescription: Shiv Trading India Private Limited is a Delhi-based trading and supply business serving the electrical manufacturing and rewinding trade.
about.introText:
Shiv Trading India Private Limited trades in and supplies electrical winding and insulation materials from Bhagirath Palace, Chandni Chowk, in New Delhi. We have been doing it for approximately twenty-five years.

We are a trading and supply business, not a manufacturer. What we bring is range, availability and specification knowledge: we hold the materials that transformer builders, motor manufacturers and rewinding workshops need, and we know enough about them to help you order the right thing the first time.
about.supplyText: Our range covers both sides of a winding: the conductor and the insulation around it.

approachItems.title: Specification first
approachItems.description: Tell us the diameter, thermal class, thickness or grade you need. If the specification is unclear, we will ask rather than guess.

approachItems.title: Honest availability
approachItems.description: Stock position is stated plainly. Where an item has to be arranged, we say so up front along with a realistic timeline.

approachItems.title: Quotation against current rates
approachItems.description: Copper and aluminium prices move with the metal market, so quotations are issued against the rate on the day of enquiry.

approachItems.title: Repeat supply
approachItems.description: Once we have supplied to a specification, reordering is straightforward -- the details stay on file.

about.experienceText:
Winding and insulation materials look interchangeable on a price list and are not. A Class F enamel in a Class H application, kraft paper where aramid was specified, or a film that is a shade too thin for the slot -- these are the problems that come back as warranty claims months later.

Twenty-five years of handling these materials is mostly useful for catching that kind of thing before it ships.

homepage.aboutText:
Shiv Trading India Private Limited is a trading and supply business dealing in electrical winding and insulation materials. We are not a manufacturer -- our role is to hold the range, know the specifications, and get the right material to you without a long chain of intermediaries.

Twenty-five years of working with transformer manufacturers, rewinding shops and equipment makers means we can usually tell from a short conversation which grade and thermal class a job actually needs.
